title: Fleet Management System
seo_title: Fleet Management System | Achala IT Solutions
meta_description: Fleet Management System (FMS) delivers real-time tracking, predictive maintenance and telematics — workforce efficiency up 40% in published deployments.

blocks.x: Mission-critical fleets, ready when they are needed. FMS combines real-time tracking, predictive maintenance, telematics analytics and compliance management in one platform.

FMS is the operating system for a vehicle fleet. It tracks every vehicle live, predicts maintenance before breakdowns, analyzes telematics to improve how vehicles and crews are used, and keeps compliance records current. Published deployments report workforce efficiency gains of up to 40%.

items: Every vehicle's location and status, live
Service scheduled from usage and condition data, not guesswork
Fuel, idle time, routes and driver behavior, with the levers to fix them
Permits, inspections and duty-time records kept current automatically

blocks.x: Telematics devices stream into a cloud data platform; rules and machine-learning models turn the stream into maintenance schedules and route recommendations. The driver app and the operations dashboard read from the same data, so dispatch and drivers always agree.

items: Vehicle telemetry processed in near real time
Service triggers computed per vehicle class
One source of truth for both sides of the operation
Location and driver data access-controlled and encrypted

blocks.x: Logistics and supply-chain operators, field-service organizations, emergency fleets and corporate transport teams.
Book a briefing with the FMS team. Bring your fleet profile and we will show the maintenance and utilization picture it would produce.
